notes.title: Revision 68

notes.title: Revision 63
notes.content:
[h3]WHAT'S NEW[/h3]
 • Home changes:
	• The player now shares the same home screen party members do, acting like a generic NPC as they do while visiting a party member
		• Attempting to have a party member visit them will also make them the Active, however
	• Home menu's DUTY, ROOM and GAME entries are now moved to its own dedicated ACTIVE section
	• Renamed ROOM → CHECK to BOND
	• Added proper checks for the current game mode for when the last party member dies
	• Certain held items now have passive decay-related, ailment curing and relationship effects
		• S. SALTS now have a random chance to instantly wake a sleeping party member without being consumed, increasing Energy recovery if it doesn't
		• Battery items completely disable Hunger and Energy decay for party members with a Geo diet, and speeds up Energy recovery while asleep
		• And some other, less noticeable effects
	• (Soon-to-be) plantable items now play a sound effect when cloned by someone with Pollinate
 • Battle changes:
	• Pressing Button A during a battle now speeds them up at any time (during default/full bouts) or skips them entirely if pressed before it properly starts (during quick/P2P fights)
	• Speed ties are no longer always in the team's favour, now randomly choosing between the enemy and the teammate
	• Shadow Walker ability now acknowledges night-time during Ventures
	• Lock-On ability is no longer suppressed by Neutraliser
	• Weather-affecting abilities now activate in battles (so long as no one with Zero Weather is present)
		• If both battlers have these abilities, nothing happens
 • Items now have stats that correspond to party member's (invisible) likes and dislikes
 • Trimmed down certain translated strings that may clip with UI
 • Certain species are now functionally immortal by regular means (injuries notwithstanding)
 • Cleaned up coding for calculating food compatibility
 • Maybe some other things

[h3]WHAT'S FIXED[/h3]
• Home oddities:
	• Potential game crashes from: 
		• Attempting to quick check profiles while the player is the Active
		• Motivator ability activating on the visiting player, who doesn't have decay stats
	• Colour sprites showing up in the player character's home screen even when B/W character sprites are set
	• Certain functions not checking if the visitor is a party member, or even present at all
	• Universal stat decay not being used for anything but energy decay while awake
• Feeding erroneously checking if the consumer is the player and not a party member while calculating how much they like/dislike what they're eating
• Corrected S. SALTS not doing anything to Puppets being reverted at some point, on top of it still increasing Energy on failure
• Missing check for food that don't have two types, potentially checking for a non-existent diet value
• Weather being set in the wrong location during training battles, causing non-Clear conditions when a weather changer is present
• Potential game crash from having the player losing themselves to a (non-existent) previous form in their evolution history while calculating fondness
• Adoption scene not showing any background
• Shell skins still being selectable in the WearOS port, potentially crashing the game when switching back to a canvas shell
• Blank screen still showing up in player select while colour sprites are showing
• Worbolg and Vividera still using their old names in certain databases
• Corrected INFO → PLAYER's menu only updating the first and (non-existent) third option instead of the second, leading to INFO → PLAYER → PLAYER instead of INFO → PLAYER → ACTIVE

notes.title: R55 Hotfix
notes.content:
This update hopefully fixes an issue with the game failing to launch via Steam at all on Windows. With the switch to an x64 executable, the .exe name was switched from [i]RCAST32.exe[/i] to [i]RCAST[/i]64[i].exe [/i], with the default launch option changed accordingly. However, this didn't seem to stick on some users' end, so the file name's been changed back to how it was from the get-go.

Nothing's changed with the game itself.

notes.title: RCAST '25
notes.content:
So, everything's been kinda sorta functional now. Still some minor issues and oversights, but nothing particularly game-breaking lingering about. However, there's a few plans for the future and a critical colour conundrum you ought to know about…

[h2]Migrating to 64-bit[/h2]
From R55 onwards, this game'll only be targeting x64 on all fronts. Still ain't clear how functional the 32-bit version was on Linux, but for the longest time the game just didn't launch without debug on Windows… which may or may not have leaked in to a few older revisions. If nothing else, it'd be good to not have that (DEBUG) text in the window title at all times.

[h2]The Updates[/h2]
So, there's two big updates in the works set for releasing sometime around late August and December, the latter of the two hopefully kicking off the transition from Early Access to Full Release. There's still at least one more Minor Update to sift through first before Summer kicks off, if only to clear up some plain unfinished things like unique area backgrounds, species-specific speech lines and more actually usable/non-passive items.

There's not too many big things set in stone for now, but here's some features to look forward to…

[list]
[*] [b]Better Battling[/b]: As is, both regular and quick/connection battles are totally automatic without any input from the player, or any effects in the former sort of battles beyond damage modifiers and recoil. One thing that's sure to be in the next major update is proper commanding, status effects and and other, mainly Duty-related events during regular battles.
[*] [b]Extra Battle Facilities[/b]: Beyond the pre-set Tourneys and waves of Night Raids, there's also a proper tournament mode in Arenas with a range of regular and special NPCs alike, and a great gauntlet in the Tower, using your entire party to face the entire roster... once the final major update of the year hits.
[*] [b]Timed Events[/b]: With the date system already in place and really not used for much beyond expiring quests and moving party members at work/school/whatever, there'll also be some new in-game events to watch out for, be it parties, special minigames or outbreaks of something rare during Ventures...
[*] [b]Roamers[/b]: While you're idling at home, taking quests or Venturing out, other Reverians may appear to challenge your teammates or ask for assistance - and may still linger around once the deed is done as a rival, friend, or potential new recruit.
[*] [b]Creature Creators Update[/b]: Here's a fun fact - out of the final(ish) roster of 220, 20 of them are just are variants of one specific species. More to the point, there's 20 reserved spots for… goodness knows what, really. One day, I'd like to call in some fan-made submissions to fill in [i]some[/i] of these unused slots, perhaps during or after this year. More on that some other time.
[*] [b]Some Other Things™[/b]: Also soon to be includes gardening at home, visiting other homelands, relations/breeding and..?
[/list]
[h2]Full Colour Sprites[/h2]
This feature's the one's been requested above all else, and honestly? I'm not at all chuffed about that. Still, while I'm not opposed to implementing this, there's only one little problem…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057292/d12343086485133123409efff47f08bcb8711abd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057292/9698cfd9edbec3cfd6977ed82afa1b7a568996b1.png[/img]

…each species has two colour alts, but only one sprite sheet per species. Couple that with goodness-knows how many sprites are already completed (even including items), and it's all maybe a bit much to ask. In other words, colour sprites aren't completely out of the question, but they're just gonna take a while.

…That's about it for now. Thanks for looking, and look out for more revisional updates starting next month.

notes.title: The Spectrum Update
notes.content:
[h2]WHAT'S NEW[/h2]

[list]
[*] 11 species added (114 unique, 135 total)
[*] 10 tourneys added (50 total)
[*] 13 areas added (83 total)
[*] Party members may now attempt to move in to the home screen or just leave for a while
[*] Party members who instinctively or genuinely don't like one another can and will fight each other while at home; the loser doesn't incur any extra battles nor a true loss in their records, but may end up injured
[*] Others who really like the Active Reverian are a lot more likely to break in
[*] Item/Egg trading implemented
[*] The game now auto-saves after every successful interaction
[*] Connecting to others of an opposing version/mode will unlock something nice for both the host and client
[*] Party members in a bad mood might not undergo any Hunger decay while on the home screen
[*] Visitors may now attempt to leave on their own accord depending on their current state
[*] Wraiths may attempt to feed off of other party members' Spirit depending on their fondness
[*] Certain species are now guaranteed to obey no matter what
[*] Weather conditions now bleed into battle and directly bolster certain abilities/species/types, or damage participants outright
[*] Adjusted recruitment bonus from Poaching quests
[*] The 7★ Primal boss zones now have recruitment enabled
[*] Weather conditions now bleed into battle and directly affect certain abilities/species
[*] Vampire ability no longer bypasses Violator
[*] Reduced redundancies in gauging what battlers do
[*] Reimplemented controller support for non-Steam builds
[*] Added LCD toggles and (volatile) fullscreen zoom for Android
[*] Randomized SLOTS selection
[*] Reduced redundancies in ability detection
[*] Consolidated home screen actions for the Active Reverian and their visitor (minus Home Events)
[*] And some other things
[/list]

[h2]WHAT'S FIXED[/h2]

[list]
[*] Finally fixed Energy decay not budging for an asleep Active Reverian
[*] Game crash from not having anyone available to see off a party (member) going away
[*] Potential game crash from a teammate attempting to say something that doesn't yet exist during Night Raids and Ventures
[*] Game crash from Voyage/Gig/School pointing to Venture/Night Raid status screens instead of the Away screen
[*] Missing response during certain Night Raid downtime speeches
[*] Canvas selection counts not updating correcly and a game crash from missing sheet names
[*] Corrected missing glasses on Handler Ferozeon's sad sprite
[*] Placeholder species speech being left over
[*] Species from the Imago Update not being considered as released (if still obtainable by regular means)
[*] Venture encounter menu not updating
[*] Tourney list including future tourneys with unfinished/undefined species
[*] Valzaios incorrectly picking up on the presence of female players instead of female party members while undergoing fondness-related stat decay
[*] Maybe some other things
[/list]

notes.title: The Launch
notes.content:
Greetings gazers!

As of today, Riftcast has now launched on Steam... somewhat, prematurely. The 24th just doesn't count as a valid release date is all.

So anyway, I'd like to give my thanks to everyone who's pitched in with feedback and support. You've all been a bunch of wonderful peeps, and I really hope y'all enjoy this game. Do tell of what you're getting up to, and any funnies and secrets you come across!

For those that are just joining in, here's the gist of what's up, so far...

[list]
[*] Raise a team of up to 20 Reverians, one-by-one or all at once
[*] Over 100 obtainable species to raise
[*] Go on quests to increase your rank and unlock more areas
[*] Face off against foes in Ventures, Night Raids and Tourneys
[*] Play minigames to train and bond with your party party
[*] Send out party members in search of items, money and experience
[*] Connect with other users over P2P to fight and trade
[*] And some other things...
[/list]

Thanks for looking, and stay tuned [i]real[/i] soon for a major update...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025320
